comparisons.compatibility_note: New NTO runtime source freeze f4446e54ec46d979ee40b823663401bee719f97a; equivalent commits with identical bound runtime files retain their actual Git identities. Unchanged controls retain their original source/configuration. Resolved configuration differs only by explicit IPOPT linear_solver=spral, spral_order=metis and spral_scaling=mc64; early_accept_validated stays disabled. Frozen inputs, robot/collision geometry, numerical validation protocol, motion limits, 60-second cold deadline, paired seeds and DRM identities are checked before export. The exact reviewed validator source pair changes only the specific nonpositive B-spline-duration rejection message; its accepted candidate set is unchanged. Source changes additionally contain read-only model audit and evidence/accounting repairs; all rows use the common current saved-output acceptance. Old NTO profiles not rerun are explicitly historical configurations. No outcome-based substitution or best-of retry.
